title: Installation
summary: We had our Club President & his BOD installation ceremony held @ The Club, DN Nagar, Andheri West @ 19:30Hrs followed by dinner.
description: We had our Club President & his BOD installation ceremony held @ The Club, DN Nagar, Andheri West @ 19:30Hrs followed by dinner.
